maria (oncall): swapping primary now — quick brief before I hand over coverage. main risks: KV cache cold starts, embeddings queue spikes, and the rate-limit edge case on 10k+ tps customers. I'll be primary for ~45m then handoff to akshay. :rotating_light:

pagerbot: INCIDENT #4521 -> paging maria (oncall), sam (platform). Severity: P2. Summary: increased 5xx on inference nodes in eu-west-1. Link: https://redwood.incidents/4521

maria (oncall): timeline: saw error rise ~02:14 UTC, mitigated partially by scaling workers but queue latency still high. Current mitigation: scaled ded. pool + enabled fallback routing to q4-embed-small. Need checks from platform and runtime before I step out.

sam (platform): copying runbooks here — quick pointers: runbook-kv-cache, runbook-embed-queue, runbook-rate-limit. internal links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embed-queue https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rate-limit

maria (oncall): exact things to verify before swap:
• KV: prefix hit-rate, replication lag, number of stale shards.
• Embeddings: backlog size > 300 -> increase pool or enable spill-to-disk.
• Rate-limit: check per-customer throttles; high-volume tenants flagged in /ops/tenants.

akshay (sre): quick commands I use to triage KV + workers — paste into ops shell:
```
# KV cache health
redwoodctl kv status --region eu-west-1 --summary
redwoodctl kv shards --list | grep stale

# check embed queue depth
redwoodctl queue inspect embeddings --region eu-west-1 --max-age 600

# drain + restart a worker safely
redwoodctl worker drain --id worker-42 && redwoodctl worker restart --id worker-42
```

jane (eng-runtime): note on graceful fallback: if embeddings latency > 4s for 2+ min, the routing policy auto-switches to q4-embed-small; to force it manually run:
```
redwoodctl routing override --model q4-embed-small --reason "mitigation" --expires 15m
```
That triggers warmup; check logs for warm-kv-writes.

sam (platform): customer-impact checklist (short):
1) Run quick query for top-5 errored API keys: `redwoodctl metrics errors --top 5 --window 15m`
2) Create incident customer impact note: use template https://redwood.internal/ops/incidents/customer-impact-template.md
3) Post status to #status-page if > 50 customers affected or SLA error > 0.5%

maria (oncall): cheat-sheet of what I'll do before handing off: 
- Confirm KV hit-rate > 80% or file a mitigation ticket with storage team.
- Ensure embed backlog < 200 or increase pool + enable spill.
- Validate fallback routing active and a canary request returns expected smaller model.
- Annotate any tenant-specific throttles (copy IDs here).

akshay (sre): if you see sudden token-billing noise or quota errors, check the quota-proxy logs and run quick rollback for recent quota rule changes:
```
redwoodctl quota changes list --since 2h
redwoodctl quota rollback --rule <rule-id>
```

maria (oncall): escalation: if error rate not improving after these steps for 15m escalate to eng-runtime and paging rotation (page: jane (eng-runtime) -> eng-ml on-call). use pager escalation link: https://redwood.internal/ops/escalation

pagerbot: Deploy bot: Canary deploy 2026.03.14-207 succeeded in eu-west-1 at 02:36 UTC (no post-deploy regressions detected).

maria (oncall): ok swapping now. akshay, I'll leave session notes pinned in the incident: short summary, which tenants I touched, and any ongoing actions. akshay please accept primary when you see the `PRIMARY_ACCEPT` message. I'll stay reachable via DM for 15m. :white_check_mark:

akshay (sre): got it — will take over and run the checks in the commands above. if anything odd, I'll page jane and escalate.

maria (oncall): final: quick link dump for the handoff: runbooks + incident dashboard + customer template:
- https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-cache
- https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embed-queue
- https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rate-limit
- https://redwood.incidents/4521
- https://redwood.internal/ops/incidents/customer-impact-template.md

maria (oncall): PRIMARY_ACCEPT
